_meta.what: Where each table's content belongs on screen. The audit derives whether it is THERE; this file only declares where it should be, so a table can never be quietly built, shipped and forgotten.
_meta.surface: A `DetailSection` case from Piru/Data/Services/UserProfile.swift, or a named screen. The DisclosurePolicy matrix already decides how much of it a Casual reader sees, so density is not a reason to leave a table unrendered.
_meta.none: surface: null means the table is deliberately not user-facing — build plumbing, identifiers, or a lookup another table renders through.
_meta.renders_as: Columns whose value reaches a view under a different Swift name (a struct property built in the query). Without these the grep reports a rendered value as dropped.

class_representatives.note: the tolerance engine's per-class PK stand-in; what reaches the screen is the representative substance's own pharmacology, resolved through this pointer

opioid_mme.note: the opioid converter tool, and the tolerance engine's missing-PK fallback; counterpart of diazepam_equivalents

substance_flags.note: missold-as-mdma drives the Monoamine Profile card's mis-sold callout; suppresses-serotonin-synthesis is engine-only (it splits the SERT recovery clock) and renders through the tolerance readout, not as a row

biased_agonism.note: UNRENDERED — a binding row says a drug hits the receptor; this says which pathway it favours, which is the whole reason two agonists at one target feel different

downstream_signalling.note: UNRENDERED — 690 rows of what happens after the receptor binds, which is the half of a mechanism a target list cannot state

neuroimaging.note: UNRENDERED — human occupancy/imaging evidence for a target claim

pharmacogenetics.note: UNRENDERED — CYP2D6NoteSection already asks the user for their metabolizer status and answers with hardcoded generic prose; these are the substance-specific cited answers, for CYP2C19/2B6/3A4 too

concentration_effects.note: UNRENDERED — the plasma-concentration thresholds that would give the PK curve a labelled y-axis

drug_interactions_pk.note: measured pair PK; rendered on the substance page but never against what the user logged

interaction_rules.note: the class matrix InteractionChecker resolves every pairing through

substance_interaction_classes.note: name → interaction class, overriding the substance's category

category_interaction_classes.note: the per-category fallback when no name override matches

tolerance_modulation.note: mu edges scaling one class's tolerance development while a modulator is onboard

class_citations.note: UNREAD — the citations behind a class-level claim

class_contexts.note: UNREAD — shared mechanism / shared PK / shared safety / SAR per class; a class screen's entire content

substance_classes.note: UNREAD — which substances belong to a class context
